name: stri_trans_isnfkc_casefold
title: Test whether strings are in NFKC_Casefold

origin.description: Report whether each string is already in NFKC_Casefold.
origin.details: TRUE when the string is unchanged by NFKC_Casefold. Lower-case abc is TRUE. ABC is FALSE because of case, and a soft hyphen is FALSE because that character is removed. An empty string is TRUE. A missing value stays missing.
origin.value: A logical vector of the same length as str.

translation.description: Report whether each string is already in NFKC_Casefold.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list or tuple of those.

translation.details: The string is in NFKC_Casefold when stri_trans_nfkc_casefold returns it unchanged. An empty string is True. NA stays NA.
translation.value: True or False, or a list of those values when str is a list or tuple.
translation.example:
from stringi.normalize import stri_trans_isnfkc_casefold
print(f"stri_trans_isnfkc_casefold of ABC returns {stri_trans_isnfkc_casefold('AbC')}.")
